_meta.purpose: Crosswalk from 'Living landscape' registry values to canonical MOSAIC living-landscape CODES. The registry now uses controlled 'CODE — Name' values (dropdown, Reference sheet cols K–M); legacy free-text variants are kept so older copies of the registry still resolve. Feeds frontend datasets.json 'living_landscape' (CODE) and STAC 'mosaic:living_landscape'.
_meta.code_scheme: COUNTRY3-XX (ISO3 + mnemonic) or basin prefix (MEK). Special codes: NATIONAL (country-wide coverage; resolved to the country's landscape collection with mosaic:coverage=national) and GLB (global / cross-landscape).
_meta.status: CANONICAL — list approved by Lizeth 2026-07-21, derived from the delineation shapefiles in MOSAIC_LLV_delim. PER-PCL is pending confirmation with the Peru team (reference map said Apurimac; delivered shapefile is Pucallpa/Ucayali). Boundaries: boundaries/<CODE>.geojson.
_meta.match_rule: Engineer: trim + lowercase before matching free_text. Values shaped 'CODE — Name' short-circuit on the CODE prefix in vocab.py. Unmatched values -> NATIONAL if country known, else GLB, and flag for review.
_meta.checked: github.com/CGIAR-Climate-Data-Hub/metadata vocab/geography.json (UN M49) confirmed 2026-06-22; geography for Country is UN M49, but living_landscape is MOSAIC-specific (mosaic:living_landscape) with no CDH equivalent.
